_source: plans/evil-mode-rework Part 3 §3 (tiers, rooms, outside buildings), Part 6 §3 (HQ menu), Part 9 A21 (clean money, Defense) and A22 (going broke, loans); lists/buildings.md §1 (building tiers)

levels.name: The Warehouse
levels.look: Leaking roof, one bulb, crates for chairs

levels.name: Hideout
levels.look: Patched roof, a real door, a sign with your emblem spray-painted

levels.name: Compound
levels.look: A fenced yard, a second floor, guard dogs (Houndour)

levels.name: Fortress
levels.look: Steel walls, cameras, a battle arena

levels.name: Tower
levels.look: A skyscraper in the region's biggest city

levels.name: Citadel
levels.look: Your emblem on the skyline, a landing pad, a throne room

lines.upgradeStart: Work starts on the {name}. Three days of dust and noise; Defense is halved until it's done.
lines.upgradeDone: The {name} is finished. HQ Lv. {lv}: level cap {cap}, crew {crew}, {slots} room slots.
lines.building: Work starts on the {name}: ready in {days} day{s}.
lines.noClean: Upgrades take clean money: ₽{clean} clean of ₽{cost}. Launder through a Front first.
lines.noSlot: No free room slot: upgrade the HQ or sell a room.
lines.needsHeld: Build it in a district you hold.
lines.busy: Work is already going on there.
lines.upgrading: The HQ is already being upgraded.
lines.top: The HQ is at its top level.
lines.maxTier: The {name} can't go higher yet: HQ Lv. {lv} and region {region} cap it at T{t}.
lines.waits: Opens with a later part of the build ({slice}).
lines.launder: ₽{amount} goes through the {front} ({fee}% fee): ₽{net} comes back clean {when}.
lines.noFront: No Front to launder through: build a Front Shop in a held district, a Laundering Room or a Front Office.
lines.unpaid: Upkeep unpaid: every building loses {n} Condition.
lines.destroyed: The {name} fell apart (Condition 0). It can be rebuilt at {pct}% cost, one tier lower.
lines.broke: Broke: the {name} is shut until the bills are paid, wages went unpaid and HQ Defense is down {n}.
lines.brokeNoRoom: Broke: wages went unpaid and HQ Defense is down {n}.
lines.unbroke: The bills are paid. The {name} opens again.
lines.loanTaken: A Fence lends you ₽{amount}. They want it back with {rate}% a week, within {weeks} weeks.
lines.loanGrows: The Fence's loan grows {rate}%: ₽{owed} owed (week {week} of {weeks}).
lines.loanTakes: The Fence comes for what's owed and takes the {name}.
lines.loanTakesNothing: The Fence comes for what's owed. There's nothing to take, so they take it out of your hide: Heat +10 at the HQ.
lines.loanMax: The Fence lends up to ₽{max} at HQ Lv. {lv}.
lines.letGo: {name} leaves with their Pokémon. Wages −₽{wage} a week.
lines.lastMember: You can't let your last member go.
lines.storageFull: The stores are full ({cap}): {n} Pokémon had to be let go.
lines.safehouse: The safehouse in {district} is quiet: Heat there −{n}.
lines.control: Your buildings hold their ground: Control +{n} in {where}.
lines.morale: The crew likes the new rooms: Morale +{morale}, Loyalty +{loyalty}.
lines.repair: The buildings are patched up: Condition +{n}.
